code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O2 saturation/PaO2), mild thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, and elevated ferritin and INR. These findings suggest significant respiratory compromise with possible infection or inflammation, and mild coagulopathy. Immediate clinical assessment and management of respiratory failure and underlying causes are recommended.
